errors.evidence: The description uses the figure caption from the paper to state the purpose but omits the actual title written on the chart, which is 'Индустрия (с изкл. на строителството) Общо' (Industry (excl. construction) Total).
The Y-axis is not labeled. The text 'Индустрия (с изкл. на строителството) Общо' is the title of the chart, not a label for the Y-axis.
The description fails to mention the dotted trendline that accompanies the solid blue line.

errors.text_span: След това линията се стабилизира около стойност 31,0 и в края на графиката леко се покачва до стойност около 32,0.
errors.evidence: This description simplifies the trend by omitting the fact that the line dips to its lowest point (around 29.5-30.0) before rising again at the end. It incorrectly suggests a period of stabilization.
The line itself does not have visible markers. The markers belong to the dotted trendline, which is not mentioned.
